eyebrow: PROJECT 01 · AI PIPELINE & LOCAL HYBRID RAG
title: Property Intelligence: Anti-Hallucination AI & Local Vector Search
plainPitch: An automated 18-step AI pipeline that audits real-estate listings, analyzes room photos, matches interior furniture using local Vector + Keyword RAG, and blocks LLM hallucinations with 200 strict JSON schemas.
diagramHint: Click any block in the architecture diagram below to inspect how it works and view live visual evidence:

nodes.title: Data & Maps Ingestion
nodes.plainSummary: Pulls verified location facts from Overture Maps, Google Places, and official Spanish registries using DuckDB Spatial.
drawerBullets: Runs SQL geospatial joins directly on Overture Maps via DuckDB (httpfs + spatial) and Shapely 2.0 geometry buffers.
Collects portal photos and raw HTML via persistent Playwright Chrome CDP and signs every binary asset with a SHA-256 hash.
Missing official data (like flood raster NoData cells) is strictly stored as UNKNOWN rather than guessed.

githubSectionLink.label: View Geospatial Pipeline Diagram on GitHub

nodes.title: Vision AI & Camera Math
nodes.plainSummary: Detects room layout and staging gaps with Gemini Vision while deterministic Python math corrects wide-angle lens distortion.
drawerBullets: Separates pixel observations (room type, lighting, fixtures) from deterministic camera calibration so the LLM never invents room measurements.
Includes Manhattan-world camera auto-calibration, a 2D spatial clearance linter, and layered SVG floorplan generation.

githubSectionLink.label: View Vision & SVG Projection Diagram on GitHub

nodes.title: Local Vector + BM25 RAG
nodes.plainSummary: Matches interior products offline by combining Tantivy BM25 keyword search with local ONNX 384-d embeddings and Beam Search.
drawerBullets: Lane 1: Tantivy 0.26.2 (Rust BM25) finds exact matches on materials, dimensions, and SKU attributes.
Lane 2: ONNX Runtime 1.31.0 encodes text locally with intfloat/multilingual-e5-small (384-d mean-pooled, L2-normalized vectors) after checking SHA-256 model file hashes.
Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60) merges both top-100 lists and feeds a Beam Search optimizer for compatible room ensembles.

githubSectionLink.label: View Hybrid RAG Diagram & Schema on GitHub

nodes.title: Hallucination Gate & Repair
nodes.plainSummary: Checks every AI claim against 200 JSON schemas, auto-repairs broken outputs, and resumes from checkpoints without re-running costly steps.
drawerBullets: Built with SingleActionStage, ItemSequenceStage, CheckpointManager, and StageLogger span tracing across stages S01 to S18.
Locks synthesis models to web_access: false and runs SemanticConservationValidator so AI cannot overwrite observed facts or invent lift percentages.

githubSectionLink.label: View Epistemic Validator Diagram on GitHub

nodes.title: Clean React 19 UI
nodes.plainSummary: Renders the audited report and SVG floorplans inside an isolated React 19 + Tailwind app that only accepts validated JSON.
drawerBullets: Python remains the single analytical source of truth; the React 19 frontend has zero direct scraping or LLM logic.
A build bridge (sync-listing-data.mjs) verifies schema compliance before staging JSON view-models for static hosting.
